breaking.change: Behaviour change: `rootMotion: "off"` (og.Skeleton's default) now does what it says. The root joint's horizontal (xz) travel is held at its rest place, so a travelling clip such as a run or a swing on a rope plays on the spot. Before, the root joint still travelled and carried the drawn body away from the entity. The root keeps its height (a bob, a crouch, a jump) and its turns. An in-place clip whose hips sway sideways now holds the hips still and lets the feet sway instead. Games without travelling clips see no change.
breaking.fix: Remove any workaround that played a travelling clip in place, such as `rootMotion: "full"` plus overwriting og.Transform every tick; `off` alone holds it. A clip whose drawn travel was wanted while the entity stood still has no mode for that now: move the entity with `planar` or `full`. Where held hips make planted feet slide, add og.FootLock.
